info.title: Keys
info.description: Renting in Nigeria without paying a stranger for a flat that was already let.

checked.description: Always true. Present so that "we checked and found nothing" cannot be confused with "the request failed".

upheldReports.description: Reports a person reviewed and upheld. Never a count of submissions.

everyReportHadRightOfReply.description: False if any published report went unanswered within its reply window.

meaning.description: Plain words for the reader. Zero upheld is not a clean bill of health.

notUpheld.description: Dismissed or found to have insufficient evidence. The number nobody in this market publishes.

medianDaysToDecision.description: Median, not mean — one stalled case must not hide the typical wait.

description.description: A report nobody can assess cannot be upheld.

token.description: The token texted to the number that was reported.

decisions.description: What each reviewer decided. Named, because "a reviewer" is not an answer to "who decided this".

waiting.description: Reports waiting. This is the constraint on how fast Keys can open a city.

note.description: What the evidence was. A reviewer auditing this later reads exactly this.

source.description: How it reached you. Phase 1 has no upload; phase 3 replaces this with files.

reasoning.description: Why. Mandatory: this is the audit record for a public claim about a named person, and somebody may have to answer for it a year from now.

nowVisiblePublicly.description: Said out loud so a reviewer knows what they just did in public.

token.description: Shown once. Keys does not store it, only its digest.

tier.description: Computed from evidence on every read. Not stored.

meaning.description: What was actually checked, in words a tenant could go and verify.

confirmedProperties.description: Properties a landlord has confirmed they may let.

upheldReports.description: Upheld scam reports against this agent. Zero is not a clean bill of health.

propertyId.description: The property this authority would cover.

landlordPhone.description: The landlord's number. Not the agent's.

challengeId.description: Given to the landlord, not to the agent.

delivered.description: Whether the text could actually be sent yet.

annualRentKobo.description: Rent for the year, in kobo.

agencyFeeKobo.description: The agent fee. Zero is an answer.

cautionDepositKobo.description: Refundable at the end, payable on the day.

serviceChargeKobo.description: Service charge, where a building has one.

latitude.description: Where the property is. Optional at draft, needed before a capture can prove presence.

costs.description: What it costs. Optional at draft, needed before publication. Null is not the same as all zeroes: one is silence, the other is a claim.

whatToDo.description: A sentence with a next action in it, not a failure notice.

annualRentKobo.description: Rent for the year, in kobo.

agencyFeeKobo.description: The agent fee. Zero is an answer.

cautionDepositKobo.description: Refundable at the end, payable on the day.

serviceChargeKobo.description: Service charge, where a building has one.

moveInKobo.description: Everything payable before keys change hands, deposit included.

extrasKobo.description: What is on top of the advertised rent. The surprise, named.

agencyFeePercent.description: The agency fee as a percentage of rent. Ten is customary; this says when it is not.

confirmedAt.description: When somebody last said this is still available. Null means never.

placed.description: Whether the property has coordinates. Captures cannot prove presence without them.

stillNeeded.description: Which of the eight Verified conditions are unmet, and what to do. Empty means Verified.

costs.description: Null if the agent has not said.

code.description: The six digits from the text.

withdrawn.description: True when the code withdrew an authority rather than granting one.

unpublishedListings.description: Listings that went dark as a result. Empty on a grant.

vendor.description: The KYC vendor that ran the liveness and document check.

reference.description: The vendor's own reference for the check, so it can be re-pulled.

attestor.description: Who attested. Never a landlord's phone number.

live.description: False once withdrawn. Withdrawn evidence is kept, not deleted.

verified.description: Computed on every search from evidence. Never a stored column.

moveInKobo.description: Everything payable before keys change hands, in kobo. The comparable number — two listings advertising the same rent are not the same price, and a list showing only rent hides that.

annualRentKobo.description: Rent alone, in kobo. Sent beside the total so a reader can see the gap for themselves.

because.description: Why this is ranked where it is. Said out loud, because a ranking nobody can interrogate is one somebody will assume was bought.

label.description: The condition as a checklist row, in the reader's language.

agentMeaning.description: What was checked about the agent, in words a tenant could verify.

checks.description: Every condition, met or not. Not a badge and not a score: the list of things that were checked, which a tenant can read and disagree with.

costs.description: Null when the agent has not said, which is itself an unmet condition rather than a blank in the page.

token.description: Shown once. Keys keeps a digest and cannot return it again — see the release gates for where a client must put it.

body.description: The first thing to say. A conversation with nothing in it is not one.

otherPartyName.description: Who you are talking to. A name, never a number.

theirContact.description: The other party's number, and only once both of you have offered. Null at every other point, on every route, for everyone.

contact.description: The number you are choosing to share, here, with this person. Not read from your account — this product stores those as hashes, and a number that has to be revealed belongs only where revealing it is the point.

feeKobo.description: What the agent said they would charge, in kobo.

agreed.description: Agree to show it, or decline.

feeKobo.description: What you will charge to show it, in kobo. Zero is an answer and a claim: a tenant who is then asked for money at the door can report it.

paidKobo.description: What you were actually asked for at the door, in kobo. Required when the outcome is asked_for_more_money, and checked against what the agent declared — a complaint its own figures contradict is refused rather than filed.

publicKey.description: The device's P-256 public key, SPKI DER, base64. P-256 because that is what the Secure Enclave holds.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the media bytes, lower-case hex.

nonce.description: Once per capture. A reused one is refused.

mockLocation.description: What the OS said about the location. Signed, so it cannot be flipped.

signature.description: ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the canonical claim, DER, base64.

pixels.description: The capture itself: a Keys greyscale grid, base64. Its SHA-256 must be the one inside the signature.

meaning.description: One sentence per refusal, written for the agent.

duplicates.description: Never "blocked" here. A match opens a review; a person decides.

listingId.description: The listing that uploaded the picture second.

matchedListingId.description: The listing that already had it.

distance.description: Differing bits, out of 64. Zero is the same file.

meaning.description: What the distance means, in words a reviewer can act on.

reasoning.description: Mandatory. This is the audit record.
